import random, sys, json
sys.path.insert(0,'/app/work')
import gen2, boundary, check, subprocess, time
rng = random.Random(101)
reqs=[]; made=0; tries=0; counts={}
kinds=['budget_short','budget_tight','budget_short','cap_exact']
while made < 100 and tries < 900:
    kind = kinds[tries % len(kinds)]; tries += 1
    base = gen2.gen(rng, mode=rng.choice(['tight','tight2','mixed']))
    base['budget']=98304; base['failed_edges']=[]
    mm = boundary.min_migration_and_mlu(base)
    if mm is None: continue
    if kind=='budget_short' and mm < 2: continue
    v = boundary.variant(base, rng, kind)
    if v is None: continue
    made+=1; counts[kind]=counts.get(kind,0)+1; reqs.append(v)
print('built', len(reqs), counts, 'tries', tries)
payload=''.join(json.dumps(r)+'\n' for r in reqs).encode()
t0=time.time(); p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'/app/submission/planner.py'],input=payload,capture_output=True)
print('elapsed',round(time.time()-t0,2))
lines=p.stdout.decode().splitlines(); stats={}; fails=0
for req,line in zip(reqs,lines):
    resp=json.loads(line); stats[resp['status']]=stats.get(resp['status'],0)+1
    errs=check.check(req,resp,verbose=False)
    if errs:
        fails+=1; print('FAIL',errs); print(json.dumps(req)[:400]); print(json.dumps(resp)[:300])
        if fails>3: break
print('stats',stats,'fails',fails); print('stderr',p.stderr.decode()[:300])
"
